# Plage de Saint-Jorioz: Key Details

## Entry Prices
- **Adults (18+):** €2.60
- **Children (10-17 years):** €1.00
- **Under 10 years:** Free
- **After 16:30:** €1.00 (reduced rate)
- **Seasonal pass:** €22.00 (unlimited access July-August)
- **Off-season (Sept-June):** Free access

## Lifeguard Supervision
"Baignade surveillée par des maîtres-nageurs de 9h30 à 17h30 en juillet-août" (Lifeguard supervision 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM July-August only). No supervision outside these dates.

## Family Facilities
- Shallow-sloped sandy beach designed for families
- Paddling pool ("pataugeoire")
- Play area for young children ("aire de jeux pour les plus jeunes")
- Shaded lawn areas for relaxation
- Beach volleyball and pétanque courts

## Opening Hours & Season
- **Year-round access**
- **January 1 - June 30 & September 1 - December 31:** Free, unrestricted access
- **July 1 - August 31:** Paid access, 9:30 AM-5:30 PM (closed 7-9:30 AM for cleaning)
- Accessibility features: Amphibious wheelchairs and water ramp provided free July-August

content.content:
# Plage d'Albigny - Key Details

## Entry Price
**Free access.** "Gratuit · Accès libre" (Free · Open access). No admission fees year-round.

## Lifeguard Supervision
**July-August only, 11 AM to 7 PM.** "Maîtres-nageurs sauveteurs en juillet–août, tous les jours de 11h à 19h" (Lifeguards in July-August, daily 11 AM-7 PM). Outside this period: unsupervised swimming.

## Family-Friendly Facilities for Young Children
- **Shallow water:** "fond sablonneux avec une pente douce facilitant l'accès à l'eau pour les jeunes enfants" (sandy bottom with gentle slope facilitating water access for young children)
- **Playground:** "aires de jeux pour enfants" (children's play areas)
- **Strollers:** Flat lawn is stroller-accessible
- **Amenities:** Three free restroom blocks, two free outdoor shower stations

## Opening Hours & Season
**Year-round, 24/7 access.** "Toute l'année, accès libre jour et nuit" (Open all year, free access day and night). Best swimming season: June-September (water 20-24°C).

content.text:
Compared the two largest Lac d'Annecy beaches listed on the site.

## Entry price

| | **Plage de Saint-Jorioz** | **Plage d'Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Adults (18+) | €2.60 (July–Aug) | Free |
| Children 10–17 | €1.00 | Free |
| Under 10 | Free | Free |
| After 16:30 | €1.00 | — |
| Season pass | €22 (unlimited July–Aug) | — |
| Sept–June | Free | Free |

## Lifeguard supervision

| | **Saint-Jorioz** | **Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Period | July–August only | July–August only |
| Hours | **9:30–17:30** | **11:00–19:00** |
| Outside period | Unsupervised | Unsupervised |

Same two-month window, but the daily shifts differ by design: Saint-Jorioz opens supervision an hour and a half earlier, Albigny runs an hour and a half later.

## Recommendation: Plage de Saint-Jorioz

For a family with small children, the €2.60/adult is worth paying (kids under 10 are free anyway, so a family of two adults + two young children is €5.20/day, or €44 for two season passes):

- **A pataugeoire** — a dedicated paddling pool. Albigny has a gentle sandy slope, but that's still open lake; a shallow enclosed basin is a different level of reassurance with toddlers.
- **Supervision starts at 9:30** instead of 11:00. Small children are typically at the water early and gone by mid-afternoon nap; Albigny's 11:00–19:00 window is skewed toward teenagers and evening swimmers, leaving the morning entirely unguarded.
- **Play area for young children** plus shaded lawn — shade matters when you can't put small kids in full sun all day.
- The site describes it as the lake's only large natural sand beach with a shallow-sloped entry, which is easier on small feet than pebble.

**Choose Albigny instead if** budget is the deciding factor, you're going outside July–August (both are free and both are unsupervised then, so the price advantage of Saint-Jorioz disappears), or you want late-afternoon and early-evening swimming — Albigny is guarded until 19:00 and open day and night year-round.

One caveat worth planning around: both beaches are supervised *only* in July–August. A June or September visit means no lifeguard at either.

Sources: [Plage de Saint-Jorioz](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-de-saint-jorioz), [Plage d'Albigny](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-albigny)
